item.title: Chappell Roan parts ways with Wasserman Music Agency after CEO's Epstein-linked emails were unsealed
item.description: In a simple Instagram story posted on her social media, Chappell Roan has announced that she will be departing from her music management company Wasserman Music Agency, led by CEO Casey Wasserman.
